final: WITH oa AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan AS timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan), t AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg FROM oa), r AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS excess_over_tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC) AS rnk FROM t WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_over_tif_avg, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark
